summary: Another member cuts in before the speaker finishes an intervention.
realLife: Wayne Morse briefly let another senator speak during a 1965 evening session. Before Morse could resume, presiding officer Daniel Brewster adjourned the Senate. Brewster apologized the next day.
inGame: needs: an interruption during the player’s floor turn.
gates: A colleague is present while the player has the floor.

turns.what: The colleague waits for recognition and responds after the speaker sits down.
turns.pulledBy: The speaker declines to yield and the chair keeps the floor with them.
turns.writesBack: The minutes show two successive remarks.

turns.what: The speaker brings the unfinished page back the next morning and asks to start where the chamber stopped.
turns.pulledBy: The previous sitting ended during the interruption and the chair recognizes the speaker again.
turns.writesBack: The floor account dates the resumed remarks to the new sitting.
